title: EventEnvelope
description: Wire format for every event published to a GitScale Kafka topic by the polling outbox consumer (ADR-008). Partition key is aggregate_id (ADR-004).

event_id.description: UUID from outbox.event_id. Used for consumer-side idempotency deduplication.

aggregate_id.description: UUID of the aggregate. This is the Kafka partition key (ADR-004).

event_type.description: Dot-separated event name, e.g. 'pr.opened'. Must have a corresponding schema in plane/data/events/<domain>/<event_type>.schema.json.

schema_version.description: Payload schema version. Incremented only on breaking payload changes.

payload.description: Domain-specific event body. Shape defined in plane/data/events/<domain>/<event_type>.schema.json.

occurred_at.description: When the domain event occurred (source transaction timestamp, RFC3339 UTC). Use for event-time ordering.

published_at.description: When the outbox consumer published the event to Kafka (RFC3339 UTC).

principal_type.description: Kind of principal that caused the event. Carried from JWT-SVID claims (ADR-010).

rate_bucket.description: Billing routing key from JWT-SVID claims (ADR-010), e.g. 'agent_pro', 'human_default'.
